newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News Corp spikes up on court ruling.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News Corp spikes up on court ruling.

text.p: Shares in Rupert Murdoch's News Corp Ltd rose on Friday after the group's Australian offshoot News Ltd, won legal approval to launch his rebel rugby league competition, Super League, in Australia.
At 2.40 p.m. (0440 GMT), News Corp shares were 13 cents up at A$6.78. The shares were trading at A$6.74 before the court decision around 2.30 p.m. (0430 GMT).

"The shares have gained a little bit, but this is not the end of it as there might be another appeal and it might end up in court again, so who knows what effect it is going to have on the shares over the longer term," one broker said.
News Corp has spent A$270 million on the establishment of its rebel Super League competition.
